title: An Act Regarding the Transfer of Moose Permits to Disabled Veterans (TITLE CHANGE)

summary.text:
This bill amends the laws governing moose permit transfers to disabled veterans by the following organizations or individuals if they meet certain eligibility requirements: 1. Nonprofit veteran aid organizations based in this State that promote the mental and emotional welfare of veterans in this State by providing outdoor opportunities; 2. The employees and volunteers of nonprofit veteran aid organizations based in this State that promote the mental and emotional welfare of veterans in this State by providing outdoor opportunities; and 3. Registered Maine guides who are residents of this State.

The bill clarifies that if an eligible organization or individual transfers a moose permit to a disabled veteran, the eligible organization or individual is able to apply for a moose permit again the following year and may also start accumulating points for the public chance drawing for a moose permit the following year.
